foto-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: synthetic photorealistic studio photograph, natural believable materials, real people and objects. Exactly THREE temporal stages of the SAME plain blue candle, left-to-right: LEFT tall unlit new blue candle with wick and no flame, MIDDLE medium-height blue candle CURRENTLY BURNING with clearly visible flame and a little melted wax, RIGHT short extinguished blue candle stub with hardened melted wax and no flame. A thin gray rightward arrow below the three stages denotes time. A solid BLUE dot under the MIDDLE stage, linked by short vertical blue line, marks the PRESENT MOMENT. A RED oval encloses ONLY that MIDDLE stage, and a red arrow points to the middle stage. It communicates NOW, between what has already happened on left and what will happen later on right. Earlier and later stages slightly paler, current middle stage full color. No text, dates, numbers or lettering. Whole objects and all arrows fully inside generous white margins. No people. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
